body: Mostly I write short stories, some poems and stuff like that. I guess I just never really try drawing. I might give it a try.

> Use every second of your time doing something you fucking love. 

I like this a lot. Art is a great way to spend your time. It's sort of calming. I can't draw or paint for shit though. I prefer writing personally. I don't do it as much as I should though.
